summary: This report requests that North York Community Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 59 Palm Drive. The applicant indicates the reason for requesting removal of the tree is due to excessive sap, and its proximity to the driveway and private residence. The white spruce tree, Picea glauca, in question measures 32 cm in diameter. The City's Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable. Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision as to whether a permit may be issued when an applicant wishes to appeal the City's decision to deny a tree permit.
decided: North York Community Council: 1. Denied the permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 59 Palm Drive.
